subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw add a package postinstall loopback probe plus opt-out env var as the warning boundary for stale running gateways?
rationale: The code is additive, but install lifecycle behavior, false-positive warning policy, and new environment surface are product/compatibility choices that source review cannot decide for maintainers.

options.title: Accept After Live Proof
options.body: Require a redacted live postinstall or equivalent local-listener transcript showing the warning, then land this warning-only mitigation if maintainers accept the advisory probe risk.

options.title: Prefer Update Or Runtime Boundary
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of the update CLI warning or runtime stale-import recovery work tracked from the canonical issue.

options.title: Pause Pending Canonical Scope
options.body: Do not merge another partial mitigation until maintainers decide whether the canonical issue should be fixed by restart enforcement, visible runtime failure, update output, postinstall warning, or a combination.

recommendation.title: Accept After Live Proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted live postinstall or equivalent local-listener transcript showing the warning, then land this warning-only mitigation if maintainers accept the advisory probe risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent postinstall and upgrade-cleanup history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the product boundary decision.
